ranked.headline: ML models predict cancer treatment response from multi-omics and drug representations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply attention fusion, graph embeddings, and single-cell foundation models to predicting drug response.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking computational tools for long-read RNA modification and variant analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications benchmark nanopore modification callers, long-read isoform tools, and variant classifiers against reference data.

ranked.headline: Structure-constrained embeddings couple gene regulation to histology and spatial tissue
ranked.summary: Spatial transcriptomics and histology foundation models are now being trained with explicit graph, label, and spatial constraints.

ranked.headline: Graph and sequence fusion with optimal transport for drug-target interaction prediction
ranked.summary: Scarce labels and heterogeneous molecular data motivate graph-sequence fusion and optimal-transport alignment in recent interaction models.

ranked.headline: Latent neural representations across scales, modalities and recording types
ranked.summary: Heterogeneous fMRI, iEEG, spike and LFP recordings now yield latent representations that explicitly handle scale and modality differences.

ranked.headline: Perturbation models judged by generalizability and cross-system transportability
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks and transportability tests ask whether perturbation models generalize beyond training conditions and biological systems.

ranked.headline: Structure-based energy models predict ligand binding, RNA folding, and Cas9 activity
ranked.summary: Automated, learned, and mechanistic energy models now link conformational structure to binding, folding, and unwinding behavior.

ranked.headline: Assigning binding energetics to individual residues and side-chain conformations
ranked.summary: Recent docking, perturbation, and MD methods now resolve recognition determinants at residue and side-chain level.

ranked.headline: Standardized scoring of gene and isoform features against reference sets and datasets
ranked.summary: Benchmarking molecular features against defined reference sets is extending from bulk expression into isoform and chromatin contexts.

ranked.headline: Assemblies link genome architecture to size, repeat expansion and demographic history
ranked.summary: Chromosome-level assemblies now span brown algae to scrub-jays, letting genome architecture be compared against size and demographic history.

ranked.headline: Lineage and spatial context linked to single-cell behavior in multicellular data
ranked.summary: Scalable tracking and graph-based learning now connect lineage history and spatial neighborhoods to single-cell behavior and protein expression.

ranked.headline: Steering generative models via conditioning and constraints toward functional molecules
ranked.summary: Recent work specifies synthesis, structure, and property criteria through conditioning during generation rather than relying only on post hoc assessment.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics and metabolic modeling resolve microbial lineage-level diversity
ranked.summary: Expanded genome sampling and genome-scale models now link bacterial lineage boundaries and metabolic capacity to ecology and fitness.

ranked.headline: Single-cell data map cell-type-specific genetic regulation and drug responses
ranked.summary: Single-cell atlases from healthy and diseased tissues now link eQTL, risk and drug-response signals to specific cell types and states.

ranked.headline: Computational fixes and inference tools for single-cell and spatial transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Growing scale and cross-cohort reuse of single-cell and spatial data demand robust batch correction and reference-based annotation.

ranked.headline: Computational methods sharpen imaging of intact cells and protein structures
ranked.summary: Label-free and live-cell imaging now draw on learned denoising and self-supervised reconstruction that do not require ground-truth data.

ranked.headline: Structural and sequence data encoded as graphs and 3D windows for pattern mining
ranked.summary: Structure-resolved and sequence-derived macromolecular data are increasingly converted into computable forms for pattern discovery.

ranked.headline: RBP binding links exon usage and chromatin marks, with NMD efficiency altered in tumors
ranked.summary: RBP-dependent control of splicing and decay is now being tied to chromatin and to tumor transcriptome regulation.

ranked.headline: Learned models reduce annotation dependence in cell microscopy and cytomorphology
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs foundation models, VAEs, and synthetic training data with microscopy tasks spanning segmentation, profiling, and cell cycle inference.

ranked.headline: Pretrained encoders versus lightweight sequence embeddings for biological classification
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test when pretrained protein and genomic language models are needed versus cheaper or task-specific alternatives.

ranked.headline: Explicit models tie excitatory/inhibitory balance to network dynamics and stimulation
ranked.summary: Recent preprint and publications formalize E/I balance and stimulation effects with analytic or parameterized models tested against neural and fMRI data.

ranked.headline: Python and R tools standardise, benchmark and interval-process omics data outputs
ranked.summary: Derived-output software now spans spatial QC, proteomics benchmarking, interval operations and data standards across multiple interfaces.

ranked.headline: Computational tools refine peptide, peak, and formula identification from mass spectra
ranked.summary: Learned and database-guided models are extending identification accuracy and proteome depth from raw mass spectrometry data.

ranked.headline: Association methods resolve epistasis, dominance and regulatory structure in traits
ranked.summary: Biobank-scale data now allow non-additive, co-expression and causal-graph models of complex trait genetic architecture.

ranked.headline: Structure predictors lose reliability on disordered, amyloid, and nanobody-ligand targets
ranked.summary: Benchmarks of AlphaFold3 and peer predictors now probe failure modes on disordered, amyloid, de novo, and ligand-bound systems.

ranked.headline: Estimators for batch correction, metacells and spatial denoising in single-cell data
ranked.summary: CAMP targets millions of cells while MoDaH and STARK add statistically grounded estimators, making scalable, principled inference a current priority.

ranked.headline: LLM agents automate NGS analysis as platforms target drug exposure and combinations
ranked.summary: Agentic LLM systems now direct established bioinformatics tools, while new open platforms address metabolomics and drug combination discovery.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models of chromosome folding are constrained by experimental observables
ranked.summary: Recent chromatin and tissue models are fit to measured observables, moving mechanistic simulations toward testable state populations.

ranked.headline: Metabolic modelling and inference link microbial metabolites to host phenotypes
ranked.summary: Metabolic models, double machine learning and public multi-omics platforms are now being combined into reproducible tools for host-microbe questions.

ranked.headline: Reference-based benchmarks test analysis pipeline choices across omics data types
ranked.summary: Late-2025 preprints and papers apply systematic evaluation to single-cell, metaproteomic, and spatial proteomics analysis pipelines.

ranked.headline: k-mer sketching defines bacterial strain boundaries; ML flags horizontal gene transfer
ranked.summary: Current work applies reference-free, quantitative genomic criteria to strain classification, transfer detection, and pathogen typing.

ranked.headline: Correcting platform and batch effects in methylation and genotype inference
ranked.summary: Array and sequencing platform differences bias epigenetic clocks, GWAS mega-analyses and imputation, prompting calibration and correction workflows.

ranked.headline: Neural models constrained by explicit mechanistic form in pathway and trajectory dynamics
ranked.summary: Time-series omics, single-cell trajectories, and reaction networks now support neural models fit within explicit mechanistic frameworks.

ranked.headline: Simulation and screening method choices are being framed as reportable design decisions
ranked.summary: Free energy, residence time, and docking pre-screening methods each hinge on protocol choices that now need explicit reporting.

ranked.headline: Compact k-mer and minimizer indexes target pangenome, ancient DNA and long-read mapping
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications recombine k-mer, minimizer, MinHash and graph-path primitives for specific pangenome and sequencing analysis targets.

ranked.headline: New tools model haplotype blocks, ancestral recombination graphs and GBS data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications deliver scalable tools for ancestral recombination graph analysis, haploblock detection, and GBS simulation.

ranked.headline: Resolved genome architecture and chromatin regulation in stress and 3D genome contexts
ranked.summary: Haplotype-resolved assemblies and cross-species chromatin and G4 analyses now allow stress-responsive regulation to be tied to genome structure.

ranked.headline: Functional annotation and cross-disorder modeling extend GWAS interpretation
ranked.summary: Large psychiatric and migraine association datasets now yield cell-type, shared-factor, and locus-level biological interpretation.

ranked.headline: Neoantigen prioritization layers genomic, expression and HLA-level evidence
ranked.summary: Vaccine trials and checkpoint-blockade studies increasingly require neoantigen tools that integrate sequencing, translational and HLA-level evidence.

ranked.headline: Complete centromere and telomere assemblies reveal variation in repeat-rich genomes
ranked.summary: Long-read sequencing now resolves repeat-rich centromeres, telomeres, and retrotransposons across populations, tissues, and disease brain.
